fact: UNICEF Rwanda reports that the head teacher of Nyarubuye Primary School, Rwamagana District, frequently updates the online School Data Management System (SDMS), which records real-time data for the school's 777 students and 20 teachers, including student grades and attendance, and is used to request money to run the school; the page text carries no date of its own.
title: The Power of Internet Connectivity Enhances Learning
